Configuring retries

Relay retries failed deliveries automatically. This guide explains the defaults and how to change them for a single queue or for the whole project.

Defaults​

A failed message is retried five times, with the delay doubling after each attempt. After the last attempt the message moves to the dead letter queue, where it stays for seven days.

tip

Keep retry counts low for messages that trigger payments or emails.

Per-queue settings​

Set retries and backoff in the queue definition. Values set on a queue override the project defaults.

queues:
  billing:
    retries: 2
    backoff: linear

Changes take effect for new messages only. Messages already waiting keep the settings they were created with.
